headlines.title: Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) Dropped, So What Is Driving Attention Now?
headlines.summary: Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) is back in focus after fresh quarterly results showed 22% revenue growth, rising use of its da Vinci 5 and Ion systems, and a sizable US$450 million antitrust settlement charge. The share price reaction has been choppy. Intuitive Surgical’s stock is up 12.15% over the past 90 days and 6.15% over the past 30 days, yet down 19.92% on a year-to-date basis. headlines.title: Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) Stock Fair Value Edges Higher After Mixed Q3 Analyst Revisions
headlines.summary: Intuitive Surgical is back on many investors’ radar after a fresh tweak to its fair value estimate, which has shifted from about US$476.34 to roughly US$486.57 per share. That change sits against a mixed analyst narrative, with recent Q3 commentary balancing upbeat system placements and procedure growth against concerns about U.S. volume deceleration and higher expectations already reflected in the stock.

headlines.title: Top Research Reports for ASML, Alibaba & Intuitive Surgical
headlines.summary: Today's Research Daily features new research reports on 16 major stocks, including ASML Holding N.V. (ASML), Alibaba Group Holding Limited (BABA), Intuitive Surgical, Inc. (ISRG) as well as two micro-cap stocks, Paul Mueller Company (MUEL) and Presurance Holdings, Inc. (PRHI).

description: Intuitive Surgical, Inc. develops, manufactures, and markets products that enable physicians and healthcare providers to enhance the quality of and access to minimally invasive care in the United States and internationally. It offers the da Vinci Surgical System that enables surgical procedures using a minimally invasive approach; and Ion endoluminal system, which extends its commercial offerings beyond surgery into diagnostic endoluminal procedures enabling minimally invasive biopsies in the lung. The company also provides a suite of stapling, energy, and core instrumentation for its multi-port da Vinci surgical systems; progressive learning pathways to support the use of its technology; infrastructure of customer service and support specialists, a complement of services to its customers, including installation, repair, maintenance, 24/7 technical support, and proactive system health monitoring; and integrated digital capabilities providing connected offerings, streamlining performance for hospitals with program-enhancing insights. It sells its products through direct sales organizations, such as capital and clinical sales teams. Intuitive Surgical, Inc. was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California.
